design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast + Old Money Tech Hybrid
theme: Light mode primary for dashboards (dense data legibility) with striking Dark Mode hero on Landing Page.

typography.strategy: Old Money Tech. Classic Serif for authority and trust, paired with highly readable sterile sans-serif for dense procurement tables.

headings.usage: H1, H2, Dashboard Main Titles, Landing Page Hero.

body.usage: Forms, tooltips, paragraphs, table data, general UI.

mono.usage: Tender IDs, Countdown Timers, Currencies, Pricing.

colors.strategy: Authority, Clarity, Truth. High contrast monochrome core with one striking brand color and semantic status colors.

primary.description: Deep Sapphire Blue - instills global trust and corporate stability.

rules: Never use pure black or white; always tint slightly with the base neutral (Zinc).
Use #0033A0 strictly for primary CTAs and active states.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise textures.
Forbidden colors: Teal Blue (#1B93A4) and AI Purple (#7351B7).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Sharp edges, cardless design. 0px border-radius globally for a Brutalist/Swiss functional aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 everywhere. Expose the grid in dashboards (Grid Borders pattern).
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders for separation. If floating (e.g., dropdowns), use a sharp hard shadow: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle SVG noise overlays on the dark landing page hero to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky dashboard headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a 1px border-b.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous. p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding (p-8).
grids_and_layouts.landing_page: Bento 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical grid-cols-12 layout. Massive typography overlapping structural grid lines.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar left (w-64, dark mode surface), Main content right (light mode surface).
dashboard.data_tables: High-density. sticky header, sticky first column (Tender ID). Right-align numeric columns. Compact row height (h-10). Cardless rows with border-b.
dashboard.bid_comparison: Horizontal scroll container. Vendor columns max-w-[300px]. Highlight 'Lowest Bid' with a subtle primary background tint.

grids_and_layouts.forms: Multi-step registration. Vertical minimal stepper on the left, large cardless form fields on the right. 1-column on mobile, 2-column grid for standard inputs on desktop.

component_strategies.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary.
component_strategies.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-none, h-12, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent.
component_strategies.tables: Shadcn Table heavily customized. Remove outside borders, keep only horizontal row dividers. Use small caps for column headers.
component_strategies.cards: Do not use standard elevated cards. Use flat div containers with border-l-4 border-primary bg-muted/30 for emphasis, or standard 1px borders.
component_strategies.badges: Square corners, text-xs tracking-wider uppercase. E.g., bg-success/10 text-success border border-success/20.
component_strategies.modals_dialogs: Shadcn Dialog. Sharp corners, backdrop-blur-sm on the overlay.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a hard drop shadow appearing.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: subtle fade and slide up (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion_and_interactions.data_tables: Hovering a row slightly darkens the background (bg-muted/50).
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use a sharp horizontal progress bar fixed to the top of the screen instead of generic spinners.

media_and_images.rules: High-quality, realistic corporate and logistics photography. Do not use generic 3D illustrations.

hero_background.description: Aerial view of shipping container yard. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) for landing page hero.

registration_sidebar.description: Modern corporate glass office. Use as a sticky visual on the left side of the multi-step registration flow.

about_us.description: Diverse professionals meeting. Use for trust-building sections on the marketing site.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='tender-submit-btn').
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live for the countdown timer. aria-hidden on purely decorative images.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize a React + Tailwind + Vite/Next.js environment. Add Framer Motion and Lucide React (or Phosphor Icons).
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Setup routing for Landing, Login, Registration, Admin Dashboard, Buyer Dashboard, Vendor Dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement custom typography configuration in tailwind.config.js (Playfair Display, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono).
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build pure HTML/Tailwind for the Marketing pages to allow asymmetric layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Install Shadcn UI primitives for Dashboard elements (Table, Dialog, Tabs, Form, Select). Customize to remove border-radius.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Implement the multi-step registration form using complex state management, ensuring country-specific ID fields conditionally render based on the selected country.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Build high-density data tables for the Tender listings and Bid comparisons. Ensure sticky headers and left-aligned identifiers.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Use 'lucide-react' for all iconography. Keep icons functional and sparse.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Ensure all form actions, buttons, and navigation links include standard data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make this look like a high-end financial/procurement terminal, not a generic SaaS.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should naturally flow left-to-right.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in marketing sections, but use extremely dense, functional spacing in data tables.
